title: feat(cloud-connection): the install door's declared-rename planner is reachable read-only on a kernel service
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9AN5TcsoztpjS9TKU19Wvqu)_

Fixes #31801

Clause-②: yes (widening: a new read-only kernel service surface and new root exports) — measured: on base `ad622d30` no service answers `marketplace-install-rename-planner` and `@objectstack/cloud-connection` exports none of the rename types; on head `14baac4e` the install-local plugin registers the service in `init()` (declared in `providesServices`) and the package root exports the service name, its contract and the result types. The install door answers every request as before (its 13 rename tests are untouched and green).
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：本地安装接口里“声明了字段改名（renamedFrom）时，这次安装会搬哪些列、会拒绝哪些声明”的判断，现在以只读内核服务 `marketplace-install-rename-planner` 暴露出来；安装接口和这个服务调用同一个函数，结果类型与服务契约从包根导出。
- **为什么改**：云端托管安装要在写入前先问环境“这个改名能不能做”（cloud#3862），而且云端不能复制判断逻辑；原来这段逻辑只在安装接口内部可达。
- **风险与回滚**：纯新增只读面：服务不改列、不写账本、不持安装锁，读表失败时直接报错而不是答“没东西可搬”。安装接口行为不变（原有改名测试未改且全绿，dogfood 全量绿）。回滚即整体 revert。
- **先看**：① `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 的 `init()`（服务注册）与新私有入口 `planDeclaredRenames` ② `marketplace-install-declared-renames.ts` 末尾的服务契约 ③ `marketplace-install-local-declared-rename.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-declared-rename.test.ts`，预期 21 个测试全绿（其中 8 个是本次新增的服务对照用例）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One entry, two callers** (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`). The body of step 2c″'s planning (read the `objectql` engine, list the upgrade plan's type changes, call `planInstallDeclaredRenames`) moves out of `evaluateDeclaredRenames` into a private `planDeclaredRenames(ctx, manifestId, converted, installed)`. The door's step 2c″ calls it exactly as before and keeps its own 422 / 503 answers; the new service calls the same method. There is no second copy of the rule.
- **The service** (seam (b), a service of its own). `init()` registers `INSTALL_RENAME_PLANNER_SERVICE = 'marketplace-install-rename-planner'` beside the install door (`marketplace-install-local`), and `providesServices` declares both (ADR-0116). `plan({ manifestId, incoming, installed })` converts both bodies forward as the door does (`installed: null` = fresh install; `undefined` = no readable body, every declaration taken as pending, as the door takes it) and answers `{ carries, refusals }`. `carries` has the door's `renamesCarried` shape (`object`, `table`, `from`, `to`); `refusals` is the door's own list, with its reasons and words. It writes nothing and holds nothing; a table that cannot be read rejects the call (the door's 503).
- **Why not a member of the door's service (seam (a))**: the door's service object is the install itself (`install(request)`). A reader resolving it to ask a read-only question would be handed the write. The hosted runtime resolves this new service by name and never sees the door.
- **Root exports** (`index.ts`): `INSTALL_RENAME_PLANNER_SERVICE`, and the types `InstallRenamePlanner`, `InstallRenamePlanRequest`, `InstallRenamePlan`, `InstallRenamePlannedCarry`, `InstallRenameCarry`, `InstallRenameRefusal`, `InstallRenameRefusalReason`. `planInstallDeclaredRenames` itself stays internal.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/31801-install-rename-planner-service.md`, `@objectstack/cloud-connection` patch, carrying both declaration lines.

New public names (the seat's call, see open questions in the report): the service name `marketplace-install-rename-planner` (house pattern `marketplace-install-local`), the constant `INSTALL_RENAME_PLANNER_SERVICE` (pattern `INSTALL_LOCAL_DOOR_SERVICE`), the method `plan`, and the four contract types above.

## Tests

`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-declared-rename.test.ts` (the door's shared rename harness) gains one top-level describe, 8 cases. The harness's `mount` now runs the plugin's `init()` too, with a `registerService` that writes into the same service map `getService` reads. It returns `planner()`, which resolves the service by name. No existing `it` changed (forced test edits: none).

- A carry: the planner answers `carries: [{ object, table, from, to }]` and `refusals: []`; the driver was asked once with the door's live keys; then the door's install of the same version answers `renamesCarried` equal to the plan.
- A fresh install (`installed: null`): the same agreement.
- Four refusals (`both_columns`, `destructive_type`, `outside_package`, `transport`): the planner's `refusals` equal the door's 422 `details.refusals` word for word, and `carries` is empty.
- A table that cannot be read: the call rejects; the door answers 503.
- Writes nothing, on every case above: the driver's tables and the ledger directory are byte-equal before and after the planner call, and `carryDeclaredRenames`, `reverseDeclaredRenames`, the engine's `register` and `syncSchemas` were never called.
- A real `ObjectKernel` (`ObjectQLPlugin` + `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` + a consumer plugin from outside the package): the consumer resolves the service by name in its `start()`, and the engine it booted with answers (no driver with rename members, so a pending rename is `transport`). Nothing is installed.
- CONTROL: the door's 13 existing rename tests are unchanged and green.

<details><summary>Ablations (each red, then restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

Via `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts --anchor 'const plan = await this.planDeclaredRenames(' …`. The tests import the plugin from `src`, so no rebuild or dist leg applies.

| Mutation in the service's `plan` | Result |
|:--|:--|
| it also carries the planned tables (`carryInstallDeclaredRenames(p.tables, …)`) | 2 failed / 19 passed: the carry and fresh-install cases (`expected { …(2) } to deeply equal { …(2) }`, the table lost `company`) |
| a failed table read is swallowed into `{ tables: [], refusals: [] }` | 1 failed / 20 passed: `promise resolved "{ carries: [], refusals: [] }" instead of rejecting` |

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Hosted reach, NOT MEASURED here (carrier: cloud).** The service lives where the install door lives: the install-local plugin. Whether a hosted environment's kernel mounts that plugin is the same cross-repo question `install-local-door-service.ts` already records for the door (#31482). Where it is not mounted, `getService('marketplace-install-rename-planner')` throws, as for any absent service; cloud#3862 resolves it from the environment's kernel.
- `main` moved six commits after the base (`ad622d30` → `3487ccc1`), none touching `packages/cloud-connection/**`; not merged (standard order: merge only when main moves under the same file).
- Overlap re-checked before the first push: no open PR touches `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-*`, `install-local-door-service.ts` or `index.ts` (35 open PRs read; #31799 is an issue with no PR; #30887's self-hosted half merged as #31776).
